title: Distinct energetic blueprints diversify function of conserved protein folds.
authors: Wells, Malcolm L; Lu, Chenlin; Sultanov, Daniel; Weber, Kyle C; Ahern, Erin; Gong, Zhen; Chen, Ethan; Glasgow, Anum
one_liner_zh: 该文通过氢交换质谱、X射线晶体学和分子动力学模拟，比较细菌转录因子与其同源周质结合蛋白的能量蓝图，并设计合成转录因子，虽涉及TF-DNA体系但核心聚焦蛋白折叠能量与功能，而非TF-DNA结合位点或互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Advances in structural biology have improved our understanding of the relationship between protein structure and function, while also confirming a widely applicable principle: protein domains with highly conserved three-dimensional folds can perform radically disparate biochemical functions. To gain insight into this structural enigma, we mapped the energetic landscapes of a family of bacterial transcription factors and their anciently diverged structural homologues, the periplasmic binding proteins. Using hydrogen exchange-mass spectrometry, bioinformatics, X-ray crystallography and molecular dynamics, we uncovered an unexpected contrast: despite binding the same sugars, the two families have evolved unique 'energetic blueprints' to support their distinct functional requirements. To test if differences in ensemble energies have functional consequences, we rationally redesigned the protein fold for tunable ligand-driven transcriptional responses. Strikingly, energy-driven protein engineering produced synthetic transcription factors with the theoretically anticipated ligand-induced transcriptional outputs. Thus, decoding energetic blueprints among conserved protein folds provides diverse functional adaptations, paves an alternative roadmap for protein design, and offers a distinct approach for engineering challenging drug targets.
abstract_zh: 结构生物学的进展增进了我们对蛋白质结构与功能之间关系的理解，同时也证实了一个广泛适用的原则：具有高度保守三维折叠的蛋白质结构域可以执行截然不同的生化功能。为了深入探究这一结构之谜，我们描绘了一组细菌转录因子及其古老分化的结构同源物——周质结合蛋白——的能量景观。通过氢交换质谱、生物信息学、X射线晶体学和分子动力学，我们揭示了一个出乎意料的对比：尽管结合相同的糖类，这两个家族却演化出了独特的“能量蓝图”以支持其各自不同的功能需求。为了检验集合能量的差异是否具有功能后果，我们理性重新设计了蛋白质折叠，以实现可调谐的配体驱动转录响应。引人注目的是，能量驱动的蛋白质工程产生了具有理论预期配体诱导转录输出的合成转录因子。因此，解码保守蛋白质折叠中的能量蓝图为功能多样化提供了途径，为蛋白质设计开辟了替代路线，并为工程化具有挑战性的药物靶点提供了独特方法。
